name: CAD/mask workstation
purpose: Design masks, PCB interconnects and 3D fixtures.
geometryBrief: Monitor arms, keyboard, workstation enclosure; use an original retro case, not an invented branded model.
behaviorBrief: Layer editing, contact coordinates, net checks, design-rule warnings, versioned exports.
inputs: Versioned mask polygons, substrate outline, database units and terminal netlist
outputs: Design revision with fabrication layers, contact IDs and design-rule findings
acceptance: Round-trip a two-contact layout through GDSII. Preserve both contacts and their spacing to one database unit; a deliberately disconnected trace must fail connectivity.

name: Multiphysics workstation
purpose: Predict electric fields, tissue strain and neural response.
geometryBrief: Reuse CAD desk; sectional anatomy and device meshes on screens.
behaviorBrief: Solve explicit boundary-value problems; mesh convergence and units; display validated versus illustrative results.
inputs: Sample mesh, material properties, boundary conditions and unit-tagged solver request
outputs: Field or displacement dataset on the mesh, solver settings and convergence report
acceptance: For the electrical adapter, impose a potential difference across a uniform slab with insulated sides. The potential must be linear and total current must converge to conductivity × area × voltage / length.

name: GPU visualization node
model: NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada Generation workstation (reference configuration)
purpose: Render large anatomical datasets and train analysis models.
geometryBrief: Tower, PCIe cards, fans, ports and cable assemblies; no need for internal PCB detail initially.
behaviorBrief: Job queue, GPU memory budget, data streaming; not a hardware performance emulator.
inputs: Versioned visualization dataset, job requests, estimated byte counts and virtual memory budget
outputs: Job-state events, allocated bytes and rendered-volume reference
acceptance: Queue two volumes that each fit individually but exceed the budget together. The second starts after the first releases memory; replay yields the same event order.

name: Connectomics console
purpose: Inspect serial EM volumes and trace axons.
geometryBrief: Large displays, trackball, annotation controls; original enclosure.
behaviorBrief: Volume tiles, segment IDs, multiscale navigation, provenance and resolution indicators.
inputs: Registered volume tiles, voxel-to-world transform, segmentation labels and annotation revision
outputs: Skeleton or segment selection with world coordinates, volume ID and edit history
acceptance: Trace through the boundary of two adjacent tiles. The node at the seam must have the same world position and segment ID at both zoom levels.

name: Neural data analysis console
purpose: Sort spikes, compare trials and store signals.
geometryBrief: Shared console asset with selectable panels.
behaviorBrief: Raster, waveform, quality metrics, event synchronization and reproducible exports.
inputs: Channel map, timestamped voltage trace, spike labels and event clock
outputs: Spike/event table, waveform summaries and versioned analysis dataset
acceptance: Import a synthetic two-channel recording with four labeled spikes and a known trigger. Verify event count, channel assignment and trigger alignment within one sample after export and reload.

name: Data infrastructure
model: Custom 19-inch server rack, NAS and UPS
purpose: Store experiment histories, model assets and microscopy volumes.
geometryBrief: Rack rails, drive bays, cooling grilles, switch and patch panel.
behaviorBrief: Virtual storage and task status; no always-on heavy simulation.
inputs: Versioned sample records, binary objects, content checksums and run manifests
outputs: Archived manifest with resolvable object IDs, integrity report and restore event
acceptance: Archive and restore a run containing a mask and a trace. Both checksums and parent links must match; a modified trace must fail the integrity check.
simulationStatus: Virtual fit, power budget and archive/restore
integrationStatus: Interactive web route; archive JSON and import

name: Engineering drafting table
model: Custom adjustable drafting desk and inspection monitor
purpose: Review device dimension drawings and compare physical designs.
geometryBrief: Tilting tabletop, ruler, task lamp, paper and drawers.
behaviorBrief: Dimension annotations, drawing revision and true-scale specimen overlay.
inputs: Sample CAD outline, scale, datum and dimension annotation set
outputs: Revision-linked drawing sheet, measured dimensions and specimen overlay transform
acceptance: Overlay a 10 mm square, zoom twice and rotate the view. Its dimension stays 10 mm and its annotations remain attached to the same vertices.
